name: Zipper
idea: Run straight up from the block like pulling up a zipper, catch the ball, then hand it right back.
why: Your defender gets stuck on the screen while you zip up. Then your body works like a screen during the handoff, so the passer gets a head start to the hoop.
tryit: Zip up fast and close to your screener. After the catch, dribble one step toward your teammate and hold the ball out for them.

frames.say: {1} has the ball at the top. {2} starts low, on the block, and {4} waits near the elbow.
*Zipper:* {2} runs straight up past {4}, like pulling up a zipper. {X2} runs into {4}.
*Handoff:* {1} runs right behind {2} and takes the ball back. {X1} gets stuck on {2}.
{1} has a clear path and dribbles all the way to the hoop.
Layup! Zip up, catch, and hand it back.
